title: capacity-balanced nonlinear expert-choice Mirror
hypothesis: With per-expert fixed token capacity, one nonlinear FFN plus role-specific Givens views retains full expert-choice routed quality at lower actual bytes than a full bank and beats tied FiLM/rank-2 residual controls; unrelated role functions require private weights.
mirror_coordinate: four role-specific four-angle Givens input/output views
scope_delta: Changes routing from token-choice (MA001/002/004) to expert-choice: each expert independently selects its top capacity tokens, causing overlap and no-route cases.
controls: full experts with dense expert-choice routing
full experts with dense token-choice top-1 routing
full experts with rank-2 factorized expert-choice router
full experts with rank-2 factorized token-choice router
ordinary hard-tied expert with expert-choice routing
tied expert plus role FiLM with expert-choice routing
tied expert plus rank-2 output residual with expert-choice routing
tied expert plus Mirror views with expert-choice routing

task.data: balanced Gaussian role clouds: exactly 16 examples/role each batch; nonzero overlap between role distributions
task.structure_audit: expert-choice coverage, expert loads, role recall, dominant-token router accuracy

teacher.aligned: one frozen nonlinear FFN conjugated by per-role Givens input/output views
teacher.router_targets: supervised balanced role IDs from the synthetic data generator

development.selection_metric: mean held-out MSE across eight methods and both teacher modes

fresh.access_condition: At selected LR, aligned Mirror MSE <=1.25x full dense expert-choice MSE and payload <=0.65x full expert-choice payload; otherwise FAIL and fresh stays sealed.

routing.expert_choice: Each expert selects exactly batch_size/4 tokens by its score; overlaps are allowed, unselected tokens have zero MoE output. Selected expert logits are softmax-normalized per token.
routing.token_choice: Each token selects its single highest-scoring expert.

storage.authority: actual serialized full inference payload bytes
storage.serialization: torch.save CPU state dict plus deterministic compact JSON config

gates.development_open_fresh: Aligned Mirror MSE <=1.25x full dense expert-choice MSE and payload <=0.65x; otherwise FAIL, fresh sealed.
gates.fresh_useful_sharing: All three fresh aligned worlds: Mirror MSE <=1.10x full expert-choice, coverage/role-recall within 1 percentage point of full expert-choice, payload <=0.65x full expert-choice.
gates.mirror_specific: All aligned fresh worlds: at least 10% MSE improvement over hard tying, FiLM and rank-2 residual at no more than 10% extra bytes or active compute vs each.
gates.fail: Development access gate misses; or fresh useful-sharing gate misses in at least two worlds; or simpler controls match within 10% MSE at equal/lower bytes and compute in at least two worlds.
gates.promising: Fresh useful-sharing passes at least 2/3, or passes 3/3 while Mirror-specific Pareto gate misses due to simpler-control/storage/runtime tradeoff.
gates.not_established: Invalid split, missing runs, or irreproducible serialization/training.

boundaries: unselected tokens receive zero MoE branch output
no natural language or large-scale load-balancing claim
